paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Tuesday, batted second and started at third base for Minnesota Twins against San Francisco Giants. Minnesota Twins beat San Francisco Giants, 3-2.
Brooks Lee put his club in front in the sixth with a go-ahead single to right field on a first-pitch 88 mph changeup from Anthony Molina, changing the score from 1-1 to 2-1.
title: Brooks Lee comes through late with a go-ahead hit
